metadata.description: Marketplace for the project-view plugin: /project-view (concise project overview) and /session-view (detailed current-session engineering dashboard), both rendered as private native Artifacts.

plugins.name: project-view
plugins.description: Two commands, two zoom levels: /project-view is a concise, 30-second project overview (purpose, architecture, state, milestones, risks); /session-view is a detailed engineering dashboard for the current session (timeline, evidence, decisions, skills/tools used). Both publish a private native Artifact.
